quarantineRisk

An R package with an interactive Shiny app to explore how viral transmissibility and vaccine efficacy affect border quarantine breach risk.

Installation

You can install the development version of quarantineRisk from GitHub:

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("ETC5523-2026/etc5523-assignment-4-yfan0161-stack")

Usage

Calculate risk for a single scenario 

library(quarantineRisk)
calculate_risk(r0 = 6, ve = 0.6)

Launch the interactive app 

run_app()

Data source

Data is adapted from Zachreson et al. (2022), COVID-19 in low-tolerance border quarantine systems, Science Advances.

Website

Full documentation: https://ETC5523-2026.github.io/etc5523-assignment-4-yfan0161-stack/
